<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/navigation.ts -->
<!--
  A top bar whose first item opens a wide panel of link groups, each with an icon and a list, and an optional
  promo card. The page keeps `open`; opening on hover or click is a port contract. Axes: panel (open, closed),
  cols (2, 3), promo (none, card).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

  export type MegaMenuProps = {
    label: string;
    brand: string;
    trigger: string;
    links: NavLink[];
    groups: MegaGroup[];
    promoTitle?: string;
    promoText?: string;
    panel?: "open" | "closed";
    cols?: "2" | "3";
    promo?: "none" | "card";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    brand,
    trigger,
    links,
    groups,
    promoTitle,
    promoText,
    panel = "open",
    cols = "3",
    promo = "none",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: MegaMenuProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="header"
  class="relative border-b border-border bg-background"
  data-testid="mega-menu"
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container
    class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 py-4")}
    data-slot="container"
  >
    <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-lg font-medium" data-testid="brand">
      {brand}
    </Link>
    <NavBlock label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", label, landmarkLabel)) : label)} class="flex-1">
      <Group gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <ButtonPlain
          type="button"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"
          aria-expanded={(((panel as string) === "open") ? "true" : "false")}
          data-testid="mega-trigger"
        >
          {trigger}
          <LucideIcon name="chevron-down" size={16} />
        </ButtonPlain>
        {#each links as l (l.id)}
          <Link
            href={(l.href ?? "#/")}
            variant="default"
            aria-current={((l.id === "") ? "page" : undefined)}
            class="text-sm"
            data-testid="nav-link"
          >
            {l.name}
          </Link>
        {/each}
      </Group>
    </NavBlock>
  </Container>
</Block>
{#if ((panel as string) === "open")}
  <Box class="border-t border-border bg-card" data-testid="mega-panel">
    <Container
      class={cn(
        "mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4",
        "grid gap-8 py-6",
        (((promo as string) === "card") ? "md:grid-cols-[1fr_16rem]" : "")
      )}
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1-3")} class="gap-6" data-testid="items">
        {#each groups as g (g.id)}
          <Stack gap="2" data-testid="item">
            <Group gap="2" align="center">
              <LucideIcon name={g.icon} size={16} />
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {g.title}
              </Text>
            </Group>
            <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
              {#each g.links as item (item)}
                <ListItem>
                  <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {item}
                  </Link>
                </ListItem>
              {/each}
            </List>
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
      {#if ((promo as string) === "card")}
        <Stack gap="2" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="promo">
          <MediaFrame alt={(promoTitle ?? "")} ratio="4/3" />
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {promoTitle}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {promoText}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    </Container>
  </Box>
{/if}
